name: seedlab
description: Seed Lab: one plugin, for designing a new web page or redesigning one in your own project.

plugins.name: seedlab
plugins.description: Design a new page, or redesign one you have, in your own codebase, so it does not look AI-generated. Seed Lab draws several directions for the page, each built on an object from outside web design with a set palette; Claude sketches them for you to choose from, builds the page in your stack, and a second model reviews the screenshots. The wording behind it was picked in blind votes.
